caption: The drawing depicts three male figures, all wearing hats and dressed in clothing predominantly colored in shades of green, red, and yellow. The central and largest figure stands holding a tall spear in his right hand and has a red sash or strap across his chest. Two smaller figures, one on each side of the central figure, are similarly dressed and each holds a spear. To the right of the central figure, there is a rectangular object resembling a table or altar, decorated with red, yellow, and blue geometric and architectural patterns. The scene is contained within a rectangular frame with a scalloped arch at the top, colored in alternating red and green segments with a yellow outline. The backdrop of the drawing features draped curtains in red and green, framing the figures with a yellowish background. To the left and beneath the main drawing, two brown, wooden-like objects run vertically and horizontally, respectively, and are depicted with a textured appearance. The overall composition uses earthy tones and combines geometric and representational elements.
title: Retablo (St. Longinus)
cluster: #12 — Spanish Colonial Art of the Southwest
